controls.title: Administrative access requires MFA
controls.remediation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for all administrative identities and retest coverage.
controls.pass_reason: All observed administrative identities are protected by MFA
controls.fail_reason: One or more administrative identities are not protected by MFA

controls.title: Wildcard administrative grants are prohibited
controls.remediation: Replace wildcard grants with least-privilege actions and scoped resources.
controls.pass_reason: No wildcard administrative grant was detected
controls.fail_reason: At least one wildcard administrative grant was detected

controls.title: Control evidence remains within the freshness SLA
controls.remediation: Refresh expired evidence and document an approved exception where automation is unavailable.
controls.pass_reason: Evidence is within the configured 30-day freshness SLA
controls.fail_reason: Evidence exceeds the configured 30-day freshness SLA

controls.title: AI systems have an accountable owner
controls.remediation: Assign a business owner and technical owner to every in-scope AI system.
controls.pass_reason: Every inventoried AI system has an accountable owner
controls.fail_reason: At least one AI system lacks an accountable owner

controls.title: Direct AI interaction disclosure
controls.remediation: Add context-appropriate disclosure before or at the first direct AI interaction.
controls.pass_reason: The product exposes the configured AI-interaction disclosure
controls.fail_reason: The configured AI-interaction disclosure was not observed

controls.title: Synthetic output marking is machine-readable and detectable
controls.remediation: Implement interoperable provenance metadata or watermarking and retain detection-test evidence.
controls.pass_reason: Machine-readable marking is enabled for in-scope synthetic outputs

controls.title: Critical vendors have current assurance evidence
controls.remediation: Request current assurance evidence or approve a time-bound risk exception.
controls.pass_reason: All critical vendors have current assurance evidence
controls.fail_reason: At least one critical vendor lacks current assurance evidence

controls.title: Processor agreement and subprocessor terms require legal review
controls.manual_reason: Contract terms, controller/processor roles, transfer mechanisms, and Article 28 sufficiency require qualified legal review.
controls.remediation: Review the executed DPA, subprocessor authorization mechanism, transfer basis, and flow-down terms.

controls.title: Sensitive prompt egress is blocked or approved
controls.remediation: Block the destination, rotate exposed secrets where applicable, and route business exceptions for approval.
controls.pass_reason: No unapproved sensitive-data egress event was observed

controls.title: Critical findings meet remediation SLA
controls.remediation: Escalate overdue critical findings, document the decision, and schedule evidence-backed retesting.
controls.fail_reason: At least one critical finding is overdue
